application.question: What drove NVIDIA's full-year revenue growth in FY2026?
application.answer:
- NVIDIA’s FY2026 revenue rose 65% to $215.9 billion for the year ended January 25, 2026. Data Center was the main growth driver, with revenue up 68%, reflecting demand for accelerated computing and AI. [S9] [S10]
- Within Data Center, computing revenue grew 59%, driven by Blackwell demand. Networking revenue grew 142%, driven by the ramp of NVLink compute fabric for GB200 and GB300 systems and growth in Ethernet and InfiniBand platforms. [S7] [S8]
- Other businesses also contributed: Gaming revenue increased 41% on strong Blackwell demand; Professional Visualization grew 70% on Blackwell demand and the DGX Spark launch; Automotive grew 39% through continued adoption of NVIDIA’s self-driving platforms. [S9]
